name: Voice Clock: Talking Clock
subtitle: Talking Clock Voice Alerts
description:
Voice Clock says the time out loud, on a schedule you choose — and keeps working when the app is closed.

Most talking clocks stop after a few days. Voice Clock is built on iOS 26's alarm system, so announcements survive a force-quit and a reboot. If anything goes wrong, it tells you before you notice, and why.

ANNOUNCE THE TIME, YOUR WAY
• On the hour, or every 30, 15, 10 or 5 minutes
• Custom minute and second intervals, down to five seconds
• A five-minute heads-up before each announcement
• Active hours, quiet hours and per-weekday rules
• Four ways to say it, from "It's quarter past three" to "Three fifteen"
• Write your own phrase: "Hey — it's {time}. {message}"

TWENTY-SIX CLOCK FACES — SWIPE TO CHANGE
Swipe left or right on the clock to try another, or tap See all to browse the set by theme. The default, Tidal Dial, is a 24-hour dial where every brass tick is a moment it will speak.

Classic — Tidal Dial · Classic Analog · Rings · Minimal
Typographic — Large Type · Word Clock · Digital · Terminal · Dot Matrix · Pixel · Editorial
Retro — Flip · Nixie · Vinyl
Expressive — Neon · Love · Starfield
Instrument — Speed · Sunrise · Orbit · Chronograph
Calm — Aurora · Wave · Breathe
Luxe — Mesh · Gold

Fifteen of them move — Love beats once a second, Gold catches a shine that travels across the hour, and the Speed gauge redlines in the last minute before it speaks. All hold still with Reduce Motion on.
Keep one face everywhere, or give each surface its own.

BUILD YOUR OWN FACE
• Five layouts: centred, stacked, corner, hands, or in words
• Five typefaces, six weights, ten colours, previewed as you pick
• Your own photo as the background, from your library or the camera
• A dimming slider, so digits stay readable over a busy picture

Your photo is copied into the app and never leaves your device.

BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO NEED IT
• VoiceOver from the first screen, not bolted on afterwards
• Dynamic Type to the largest accessibility sizes
• High-contrast theme, Reduce Motion and Reduce Transparency
• Simple Mode: one enormous "Say the time" button and nothing else

YOUR OWN SOUNDS
• Record your voice — or anyone's — as the announcement
• Bring in a track, a voice memo, or any audio file
• Turn a sentence into a sound, in a system voice or your Personal Voice
• A real waveform editor: trim, fades, gain, loudness matching, speed
• Nothing is destructive. Your original file is never modified.

ALARMS AND TIMERS THAT TALK
• Alarms that speak their label — "Time to take your tablets"
• Prominent alarms ring through silent mode and Focus
• Spoken cues at halfway, 1 minute, 30 seconds and 3·2·1
• Multi-step interval timers for circuits and recipes
• Focus Sessions that announce elapsed time — "Twenty minutes in"

EVERYWHERE YOU ALREADY ARE
Apple Watch app and complications · Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets · Control Center · Siri and Shortcuts · Live Activity · iPad and Mac

TWO THINGS NOBODY ELSE HAS
Sound Check runs nine live checks and says in plain language whether the app will work, with the fix beside each.
The Delivery Log records every announcement — spoken, skipped or failed — with the reason. "Skipped 3:00 PM — you were on a call."

No account. No server. No analytics. No ad identifiers. No third-party code.
Speech is synthesised on device. Your recordings, photos, schedules and settings stay there, and sync only through your own private iCloud.

Pro adds unlimited schedules, all twenty-six faces, the face builder, Personal Voice, custom phrases, second-level intervals, the full audio editor, multi-step timers and CarPlay.
